project.name: nvim-pack
project.description: A Neovim configuration managed by nvim-pack, bundling 118 plugins for an opinionated Lua-driven editing environment.

nodes.name: .luarc.json
nodes.summary: lua-language-server config for the nvim-pack workspace. Sets runtime.version to LuaJIT, disables third-party checking, ignores .worktrees/.superpowers/.ua/.jj directories, links luv/busted/luassert libraries plus ./lua, and declares vim, PackageManager, Snacks, snacks as diagnostics globals.

nodes.name: .neoconf.json
nodes.summary: neoconf config enabling neodev library (with plugins) and the lua_ls neoconf plugin. Drives LSP setup for Neovim lua development.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guide: requires Neovim and Jujutsu, clone jolafrite/nvim-config, and boot with nvim -u ./init.lua.

nodes.name: KEYMAP.md
nodes.summary: Generated keymap reference for the config (vim.pack-based, leader `,`). Covers movement, window/pane, lines & editing, search, files, diagnostics, LSP on_attach, Snacks picker, git/gitsigns, terminal, quickfix/loclist, trouble, flash, yanky, conform format, neocodeium, noice, todo comments, grug-far, treesitter textobjects, snacks toggles, which-key, and filetype-specific bindings. Notes that all keymaps are made silent via lua/config/options.lua.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Stub README containing only the title 'nvim-config'; no substantive project documentation.

nodes.name: selene.toml
nodes.summary: Selene Lua linter config targeting the vim standard library. Allows mixed_table, multiple_statements, global_usage, unused_variable, and shadowing lints.

nodes.name: stylua.toml
nodes.summary: Stylua Lua formatter config: column_width 160, Unix line endings, 2-space indentation, AutoPreferSingle quotes, no call parentheses, collapse simple statements always, and sorted requires enabled.

nodes.name: vim.yml
nodes.summary: Vim globals manifest for the Lua toolchain (base lua51). Declares PackageManager, Snacks, vim, jit, bit, assert, package, table, string, and os as any-typed globals so the linter/typechecker recognizes Neovim runtime globals.

nodes.name: nvim-pack-lock.json
nodes.summary: nvim-pack lock file pinning 118 installed plugins (blink.cmp, conform, lualine, treesitter, snacks, etc.) each with a pinned git rev and source URL. This is the authoritative dependency manifest for the config.

nodes.name: nvim-pack-lock.json:plugins
nodes.summary: The 'plugins' table in nvim-pack-lock.json mapping 116 plugin names to their pinned revision and source URL.

nodes.name: init.lua
nodes.summary: Neovim configuration entry point. Requires utils, config submodules (options, keymaps, autocmds), package manager, and plugins loader. Applies the shades-of-purple colorscheme via pcall.

nodes.name: autocmds.lua
nodes.summary: Defines Neovim autocommands: auto-reload on focus/terminal events, conceallevel reset for json/jsonc/markdown, formatoptions cleanup, cursorline persistence across window leave/enter, and relative number toggle on mode change.

nodes.name: keymaps.lua
nodes.summary: Comprehensive keymap definitions covering navigation, window management, line moving, search, diagnostic navigation, quickfix/location list toggling, and editor utilities. Contains helper functions open_url, searching_brave, and diagnostic_goto.

nodes.name: options.lua
nodes.summary: Global Neovim options and runtime configuration: enables lazy loader, sets leader key, configures number/relativenumber, backup, spell, conceallevel, scroll settings, disables unwanted providers, and wraps vim.keymap.set to enforce silent behavior.

nodes.name: health.lua
nodes.summary: Neovim health check module for nvim-pack. Validates Neovim version (requires 0.12+), checks for external executables (git, make, unzip, rg), and provides system information via vim.uv.os_uname.

nodes.name: pack.lua
nodes.summary: Custom lualine.statusline component that displays PackageManager status. Shows a spinner while checking, pending update count when idle, and refreshes on PackStatusChanged User events. Extends lualine.component.

nodes.name: 00-snacks.lua
nodes.summary: Snacks.nvim plugin configuration with extensive keybindings for picker (files, grep, git, buffers), dashboard, toggles (spell, wrap, treesitter, zoom, zen), terminal, lazygit, and git browsing. Integrates with gitsigns via a custom toggle.

nodes.name: blink.lua
nodes.summary: Blink.cmp completion plugin configuration with 7 dependencies (colorful-menu, blink.lib, blink.indent, blink.pairs, blink-cmp-git, lazydev, vim-dadbod-completion). Configures completion menu, sources, cmdline integration, and triggers native build.

nodes.name: conform.lua
nodes.summary: Conform.nvim formatter configuration with format-on-save via BufWritePre autocmd, toggleable via <leader>cF, and manual format keymap <leader>cf. Guards against invalid buffers and non-file buftypes.

nodes.name: core.lua
nodes.summary: Defines core plugins required by other plugins: MunifTanjim/nui.nvim and nvim-lua/plenary.nvim, both loaded eagerly (lazy=false).

nodes.name: cyberdream.lua
nodes.summary: Registers scottmckendry/cyberdream.nvim colorscheme plugin via PackageManager.add, loaded eagerly.

nodes.name: e-ink.lua
nodes.summary: Registers e-ink-colorscheme/e-ink.nvim colorscheme plugin via PackageManager.add, loaded eagerly.

nodes.name: fidget.lua
nodes.summary: Registers j-hui/fidget.nvim LSP progress notification plugin, loaded on LspAttach event with default setup.

nodes.name: flash.lua
nodes.summary: Registers folke/flash.nvim navigation plugin with keymaps for jump (s), treesitter jump (S), remote (R), treesitter search (R), toggle (C-s), and incremental treesitter selection (C-space).

nodes.name: gitsigns.lua
nodes.summary: Registers lewis6991/gitsigns.nvim with custom sign glyphs and on_attach keymaps for hunk navigation ([h, ]h, [H, ]H), staging, resetting, blaming, and diffing. Uses a local map helper for buffer-local keybindings.

nodes.name: grug-far.lua
nodes.summary: Registers MagicDuck/grug-far.nvim search-and-replace plugin with <leader>sr keymap that opens a transient grug-far panel prefilled with the current file extension filter.

nodes.name: indent-blankline.lua
nodes.summary: Registers lukas-reineke/indent-blankline.nvim with custom indent char (▎), scope configuration including return_statement and table_constructor node types, loaded for all filetypes.

nodes.name: indent-o-matic.lua
nodes.summary: Registers Darazaki/indent-o-matic.nvim indentation detection plugin, loaded eagerly with skip_multiline=true, triggered on all file types via on_file_types.

nodes.name: init.lua
nodes.summary: Plugin loader that globs lua/plugins/*.lua, strips numeric prefixes from filenames, loadfiles each module, and caches in package.loaded. Calls PackageManager.load_all() and requires plugins.lang barrel.

nodes.name: kulala.lua
nodes.summary: Registers mistweaverco/kulala.nvim HTTP client plugin with global keymaps under <leader>R prefix and a node_path_resolver script option that resolves the node binary path.

nodes.name: angular.lua
nodes.summary: Angular language support: installs angular-language-server, prettierd, and oxlint via mason; configures angularls LSP for typescript/html filetypes; sets up conform formatting for htmlangular; installs treesitter parsers; configures snacks LSP utility to disable rename provider.

nodes.name: ansible.lua
nodes.summary: Ansible language support: registers mfussenegger/nvim-ansible plugin, installs ansible-language-server and ansible-lint via mason, configures ansiblels LSP for yaml.ansible filetype, registers ansible_lint linter, and adds <leader>ta keymap to run playbooks.

nodes.name: astro.lua
nodes.summary: Astro language support: installs astro-language-server via mason, configures astro LSP for .astro files, sets prettierd as conform formatter, and installs astro and css treesitter parsers.

nodes.name: biome.lua
nodes.summary: Biome language support: installs biome via mason, configures biome LSP for JS/TS/JSON/Vue/Svelte/Astro filetypes, registers biome-check conform formatter, and enables the biome LSP.

nodes.name: clangd.lua
nodes.summary: C/C++ language support: installs clangd, clang-format, and cpplint via mason; configures clangd LSP with background index, clang-tidy, and IWYU header insertion; registers clang_format conform formatter and cpplint linter for C/C++ filetypes; installs c and cpp treesitter parsers.

nodes.name: open_url
nodes.summary: Opens a URL using the platform-appropriate opener (open on macOS, xdg-open otherwise) via vim.fn.system.

nodes.name: searching_brave
nodes.summary: Searches Brave for the current<cword> by constructing a search URL and delegating to open_url.

nodes.name: diagnostic_goto
nodes.summary: Factory returning a function that jumps to the next or previous diagnostic, optionally filtered by severity level (ERROR, WARN). Uses vim.diagnostic.jump with float display.

nodes.name: check_version
nodes.summary: Checks Neovim version against 0.12 minimum. Reports OK if current version meets the threshold, error otherwise. Handles missing vim.version.ge gracefully.

nodes.name: check_external_reqs
nodes.summary: Verifies executability of git, make, unzip, and rg. Reports OK for found executables and warning for missing ones.

nodes.name: ensure_spinner
nodes.summary: Starts a uv timer that cycles through spinner frames and refreshes lualine statusline while PackageManager is in a checking state. No-op if already running.

nodes.name: stop_spinner
nodes.summary: Stops the spinner timer and resets the running flag if active.

nodes.name: format_on_save
nodes.summary: Determines whether format-on-save should run for a given buffer. Returns false if globally disabled via vim.g.conform_format_on_save or buffer-local conform_formatting flag.

nodes.name: toggle
nodes.summary: Toggles the vim.g.conform_format_on_save global flag on or off.

nodes.name: is_on
nodes.summary: Returns whether format-on-save is currently enabled by checking vim.g.conform_format_on_save against false.

nodes.name: node_path_resolver
nodes.summary: Resolves the node binary path by running 'which node' and trimming the output. Used as a kulala script option.

nodes.name: M
nodes.summary: Custom lualine.component subclass displaying PackageManager status. Defines init (merges defaults), update_status (renders spinner or pending count), and registers a PackStatusChanged autocmd for refresh. Exports the module table.

nodes.name: clojure.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Clojure. Registers Olical/conjure via PackageManager with nvim-paredit and baleia.nvim dependencies. Configures Conjure mappings (K doc, gd def), installs the Clojure treesitter parser, and on clojure/edn filetype loads conjure.main and nvim-paredit, plus optional baleia colorization with BaleiaColorize and BaleiaLogs user commands.

nodes.name: cmake.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for CMake. Registers Civitasv/cmake-tools.nvim via PackageManager. Installs neocmakelsp, cmakelang, and cmakelint via mason. Configures neocmake LSP, cmake_format conform formatter, cmakelint linter, and the CMake treesitter parser.

nodes.name: dart.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Dart. Installs the dart LSP via mason, configures dartls with pubspec.yaml root markers, registers dart_format conform formatter, installs the Dart treesitter parser, and enables the dartls LSP.

nodes.name: docker.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Docker. Installs docker-language-server, docker-compose-language-service, dockerfmt, and hadolint via mason. Configures dockerls and docker_compose_language_service LSPs, dockerfmt conform formatter, hadolint linter, and the Dockerfile treesitter parser.

nodes.name: dotnet.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for .NET. Installs omnisharp, fsautocomplete, csharpier, and fantomas via mason. Configures omnisharp (C#/VB) and fsautocomplete (F#) LSPs with Roslyn analyzers and import organization, registers csharpier and fantomas conform formatters, and installs c_sharp and fsharp treesitter parsers.

nodes.name: elixir.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Elixir. Installs elixir-ls via mason, configures elixirls LSP for elixir/eelixir/heex/surface/livebook filetypes, registers credo linter with a .credo.exs condition, installs elixir/heex/eex treesitter parsers, registers markdown treesitter language for livebook, and enables elixirls.

nodes.name: elm.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Elm. Installs elm-language-server and elm-format via mason, configures elmls LSP with elm.json root markers, registers elm_format conform formatter, installs the Elm treesitter parser, and enables elmls.

nodes.name: ember.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Ember. Installs ember-language-server via mason, configures ember LSP for handlebars/typescript/javascript filetypes with ember-cli-build.js root marker, registers prettierd conform formatter for glimmer, installs glimmer/glimmer_javascript/glimmer_typescript/css treesitter parsers, and enables ember LSP.

nodes.name: erlang.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Erlang. Installs erlang_ls via mason, configures erlangls LSP with rebar.config/erlang.mk root markers, installs the Erlang treesitter parser, and enables erlangls.

nodes.name: git.lua
nodes.summary: Minimal language plugin for Git-related filetypes. Installs treesitter parsers for git_config, gitcommit, gitattributes, gitignore, and git_rebase via pcall to avoid failures if a parser is unavailable.

nodes.name: gleam.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Gleam. Installs gleam via mason, configures gleam LSP with gleam.toml/gleam.json root markers, registers gleam conform formatter, installs the Gleam treesitter parser, and enables gleam LSP.

nodes.name: go.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Go. Registers ray-x/go.nvim via PackageManager with neotest-golang dependency. Installs gopls, golangci-lint, goimports, gofumpt, and gocondense via mason. Configures go.nvim setup, conform formatters (gofumpt, goimports, gocondense), golangci-lint linter, neotest adapter, six go-related keymaps, gopls LSP with detailed settings, and enables gopls.

nodes.name: haskell.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Haskell. Registers mrcjkb/haskell-tools.nvim via PackageManager. Installs haskell-language-server, haskell-debug-adapter, fourmolu, and hlint via mason. Configures fourmolu/cabal_fmt conform formatters, hlint linter, haskell-tools setup with on_attach keymaps (evaluate all, hoogle signature, REPL toggle), installs the Haskell treesitter parser, and loads on haskell/lhaskell filetype.

nodes.name: helm.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Helm. Installs helm-ls via mason, adds filetype patterns for template YAML and .tpl files as helm, configures helm_ls LSP with Chart.yaml root markers, installs the Helm treesitter parser, and enables helm_ls.

nodes.name: init.lua
nodes.summary: Loader for the lua/plugins/lang directory. Globs all *.lua files in the lang directory, skips init, loadfile()s each un-loaded module, and marks package.loaded['plugins.lang.<name>'] = true to prevent re-loading.

nodes.name: java.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Java. Registers mfussenegger/nvim-jdtls via PackageManager. Installs jdtls, google-java-format, checkstyle, java-debug-adapter, and java-test via mason. Defines jdtls_cmd (builds JDTLS command with lombok agent and workspace paths) and attach_jdtls (configures JDTLS capabilities, keymaps, and debug adapters), registers google_java_format conform formatter and checkstyle linter, installs the Java treesitter parser, and triggers attach_jdtls on java filetype.

nodes.name: json.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for JSON. Installs json-lsp, fixjson, and jsonlint via mason. Configures jsonls LSP (vscode-json-language-server) with optional schemastore schema integration in before_init, enables JSON format and validation settings, registers fixjson conform formatter (prettierd + fixjson for json/jsonc), registers jsonlint linter, enables jsonls, and installs json and json5 treesitter parsers.

nodes.name: julia.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Julia. Conditionally (only when julia is executable) configures julials LSP via julia -e LanguageServer runserver, with qualify completion mode and missingrefs lint set to none. Installs the Julia treesitter parser unconditionally.

nodes.name: kotlin.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Kotlin. Registers AlexandrosAlexiou/kotlin.nvim via PackageManager. Installs kotlin-language-server, ktfmt, ktlint, and kotlin-debug-adapter via mason. Configures kotlin_language_server LSP, ktlint conform formatter and linter, installs the Kotlin treesitter parser, and configures dap with kotlin launch and attach configurations (including a dynamic mainClass function deriving the class name from the buffer path).

nodes.name: lean.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Lean. Registers Julian/lean.nvim via PackageManager with nvim-lua/plenary.nvim dependency. Defines lean_opts (LSP init options, filetype nomodifiable, abbreviations, mappings, infoview, progress bars, stderr config) and calls lean.setup on lean filetype via on_file_types.

nodes.name: lua.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Lua. Installs lua-language-server, stylua, and selene via mason. Installs lua/luadoc/luap treesitter parsers. Configures lua_ls LSP with root markers (.luarc.json, .stylua.toml, selene.toml, etc.), disables documentFormattingProvider on init, enables signatureHelp/codeLens/hint, registers stylua conform formatter and selene linter (with cargo-bin path override), and enables lua_ls.

nodes.name: markdown.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Markdown. Installs marksman, markdownlint-cli2, and markdown-toc via mason. Configures marksman LSP with .marksman.toml root markers, adds mdx filetype as markdown.mdx, registers markdown-toc conform formatter (with a toc-comment condition), markdownlint-cli2 conform formatter and linter, installs markdown and markdown_inline treesitter parsers, and enables marksman.

nodes.name: nix.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Nix. Installs nil and statix via mason. Configures nil_ls LSP with flake.nix/shell.nix root markers, registers nixfmt conform formatter, statix linter, installs the Nix treesitter parser, and enables nil_ls.

nodes.name: nushell.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for Nushell. Installs nushell via mason, configures nushell LSP via nu --lsp for nu filetypes, installs the nu treesitter parser, and enables nushell LSP.

nodes.name: ocaml.lua
nodes.summary: Language plugin for OCaml. Installs ocaml-lsp via mason, configures ocamllsp LSP for ocaml/ocaml.interface/reason/dune filetypes with dune-project root markers, installs ocaml and ocaml_interface treesitter parsers, and enables ocamllsp.

nodes.name: init.lua
nodes.summary: Central utils barrel: defines gh() URL helper and re-exports install/autocmds/root/terminal/treesitter modules.
nodes.languageNotes: M.gh builds github.com/<repo> URLs; re-exports are require-based, not deep copies.

nodes.name: snacks.lua
nodes.summary: Snacks.nvim plugin entry point. Provides util.lsp.on() used by python.lua to disable ruff hover provider, and picker methods (lsp_definitions, lsp_references, lsp_implementations, lsp_type_definitions, lsp_symbols, lsp_workspace_symbols, lsp_incoming_calls, lsp_outgoing_calls, lsp_config) consumed by the global LSP keybindings in lsp.lua.
nodes.languageNotes: Cross-batch neighbor referenced by python.lua (util.lsp.on) and lsp.lua (picker methods).

nodes.name: odin.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Odin: installs ols LSP and odinfmt via mason, configures ols LSP server for 'odin' filetype, installs treesitter parser for odin, and registers odinfmt as the conform formatter for odin.
nodes.languageNotes: Straightforward LSP + formatter + treesitter registration; no conditional logic.

nodes.name: php.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for PHP: installs phpactor/php-cs-fixer/phpcs via mason, configures either phpactor or intelephense LSP based on vim.g.lazyvim_php_lsp, registers php_cs_fixer conform formatter and phpcs linter, and installs treesitter parser for php.
nodes.languageNotes: Conditional LSP selection between phpactor and intelephense driven by vim.g.lazyvim_php_lsp.

nodes.name: prisma.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Prisma: installs prisma-language-server via mason, configures prismals LSP server for 'prisma' filetype with schema.prisma root marker, installs treesitter parser for prisma, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal config; no formatter or linter registered.

nodes.name: python.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Python: installs pyright (or basedpyright) and ruff via mason, configures both LSP servers with analysis settings, disables ruff hover provider via snacks.util.lsp.on, registers ruff as conform formatter and ruff/mypy/flake8 as linters, and installs treesitter parsers for python/ninja/rst.
nodes.languageNotes: Dual LSP setup (pyright + ruff) with ruff hover disabled to avoid duplicate hover.

nodes.name: r.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for R: registers R.nvim plugin via PackageManager with filetype r/rmd/quarto, sets R.nvim options (R_args, hook with which-key localleader groups, pdfviewer), enables r_language_server LSP on R filetypes, installs treesitter parsers for r/rnoweb, and configures neotest with neotest-testthat adapter.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PackageManager.add with a config closure; which-key localleader groups are R-specific.

nodes.name: rego.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Rego: installs regols and regal via mason, configures both LSP servers for 'rego' filetype, installs treesitter parser for rego, and enables both LSPs.
nodes.languageNotes: Two LSP servers (regols + regal) for the same filetype; no formatter or linter.

nodes.name: ruby.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Ruby: installs ruby_lsp/solargraph, rubocop, standardrb, erb-formatter, erb-lint via mason; configures ruby_lsp or solargraph LSP based on vim.g.lazyvim_ruby_lsp, optionally enables rubocop LSP, registers rubocop/erb_format conform formatters, and installs treesitter parser for ruby.
nodes.languageNotes: Conditional LSP (ruby_lsp vs solargraph) and conditional rubocop LSP based on formatter choice.

nodes.name: rust.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Rust: registers rustaceanvim plugin via PackageManager with crates.nvim dependency, installs rust-analyzer/codelldb (or bacon) via mason, configures rustaceanvim with rust-analyzer settings, sets up crates.nvim, explicitly starts rustaceanvim LSP for the triggering buffer, registers rustfmt conform formatter and clippy linter, and configures neotest with rustaceanvim.neotest adapter.
nodes.languageNotes: Most complex language plugin in this batch: conditional diagnostics backend (rust-analyzer vs bacon-ls), explicit LSP start workaround for first rust buffer, neotest adapter registration.

nodes.name: scala.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Scala: registers nvim-metals plugin via PackageManager with plenary.nvim dependency, installs treesitter parser for scala, configures metals LSP with detailed settings (verboseCompilation, showImplicitArguments, excludedPackages, testUserInterface) and FileType autocmd for initialize_or_attach.
nodes.languageNotes: Metals configuration is set up via bare_config + settings table; uses FileType autocmd rather than on_attach.

nodes.name: solidity.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Solidity: installs solc via mason, conditionally configures solidity_ls LSP only when solc is executable (root markers: foundry.toml/hardhat.config.js), registers forge_fmt conform formatter, and installs treesitter parser for solidity.
nodes.languageNotes: LSP config is gated on vim.fn.executable('solc') == 1; no LSP enable if solc missing.

nodes.name: sql.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for SQL: registers vim-dadbod plugin via PackageManager with vim-dadbod-ui and vim-dadbod-completion dependencies, installs sqls and sqlfluff via mason, configures sqls LSP, registers sqlfluff conform formatter and linter for 'sql' filetype, installs treesitter parser for sql, and enables sqls LSP. Adds <leader>D keymap for DBUI toggle.
nodes.languageNotes: Only file in batch that uses PackageManager.add with dependencies array and a keymap inside config closure.

nodes.name: svelte.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Svelte: installs svelte-language-server, prettierd, and oxlint via mason, configures svelte LSP with a dynamic cmd function that resolves local svelteserver binary, registers prettierd conform formatter and oxlint linter for svelte, installs treesitter parser for svelte, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: LSP cmd is a function that checks for a local node_modules/.bin/svelteserver binary and falls back to rpc.start.

nodes.name: tailwind.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Tailwind CSS: installs tailwindcss-language-server, prettierd, and stylelint via mason, configures tailwindcss LSP for html/css/javascript/typescript/svelte/astro/templ/php/blade/mdx filetypes with includeLanguages settings, registers prettierd conform formatter for html/css/less/sass/scss/stylus and stylelint linter for css/less/sass/scss/stylus, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Cross-filetype LSP covering 12 filetypes; formatter and linter registrations span 6 CSS-related filetypes.

nodes.name: terraform.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Terraform/HCL: installs terraform-ls and tflint via mason, configures terraformls LSP for terraform/terraform-vars filetypes, registers terraform_fmt and packer_fmt conform formatters for terraform/tf/terraform-vars/hcl, registers tflint/terraform_validate linters, installs treesitter parsers for terraform and hcl, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers terraform, tf, terraform-vars, and hcl filetypes with both formatter and linter.

nodes.name: tex.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for LaTeX: registers vimtex plugin via PackageManager for tex/plaintex/bib filetypes, installs texlab via mason, configures vimtex compiler settings (tectonic method, quickfix method), configures texlab LSP, and installs treesitter parsers for bibtex and latex.
nodes.languageNotes: vimtex global settings (compiler_method, mappings_disable, quickfix_method) set before LSP config.

nodes.name: thrift.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Thrift: installs thriftls via mason, configures thriftls LSP for thrift/thrift2 filetypes, installs treesitter parser for thrift, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal config; no formatter or linter registered.

nodes.name: toml.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for TOML: installs taplo via mason, configures taplo LSP for 'toml' filetype, registers taplo conform formatter for toml, installs treesitter parser for toml, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard LSP + formatter + treesitter pattern.

nodes.name: twig.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Twig: installs twiggy-language-server, twigcs, and twig-cs-fixer via mason, configures twiggy_language_server LSP for twig/html.twig filetypes, registers twig-cs-fixer conform formatter and twigcs linter for twig, installs treesitter parser for twig, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard LSP + formatter + linter + treesitter pattern.

nodes.name: typescript.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for TypeScript/JavaScript: installs oxlint, oxfmt, and prettierd via mason, configures ts_ls LSP with inlay hints settings for typescript and javascript, configures oxlint LSP for js/ts/vue/svelte/astro/json filetypes, registers oxfmt conform formatter and prettierd formatters for js/jsx/ts/tsx, registers oxlint linters for js/jsx/ts/tsx, installs treesitter parsers for typescript/tsx/javascript, registers better-type-hover plugin via PackageManager, and adds <C-P> keymap for better type hover on TS filetypes.
nodes.languageNotes: Dual LSP (ts_ls + oxlint), dual formatter (prettierd + oxfmt), and a PackageManager-registered plugin (better-type-hover) with on_file_types keymap.

nodes.name: typst.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Typst: installs tinymist and typstyle via mason, configures tinymist LSP for 'typst' filetype with typstyle formatter mode, registers typstyle conform formatter for typst, sets conform default_format_opts for typst lsp_format='prefer', installs treesitter parser for typst, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Notable: modifies conform.default_format_opts globally for typst lsp_format preference.

nodes.name: vue.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Vue: installs vue-language-server via mason, configures vue_ls LSP for 'vue' filetype, installs treesitter parsers for vue and css, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal config; no formatter or linter registered (handled by typescript/tailwind plugins).

nodes.name: xml.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for XML: installs xmlformatter and lemminx via mason, configures lemminx LSP for xml/xsd/xsl/xslt/svg filetypes, registers xmlformatter conform formatter for xml, installs treesitter parser for xml, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers 5 XML-related filetypes with a single LSP server.

nodes.name: yaml.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for YAML: installs yaml-language-server via mason, configures yamlls LSP with foldingRange capabilities, before_init hook that merges schemastore schemas, settings disabling telemetry/schemaStore, and validation/formatting options, installs treesitter parser for yaml, and enables the LSP.
nodes.languageNotes: Only file in batch using before_init to conditionally merge schemastore schemas; disables schemaStore and sets keyOrdering=false.

nodes.name: zig.lua
nodes.summary: Language support for Zig: registers neotest-zig plugin via PackageManager for zig/zir filetypes, installs zls via mason, configures zls LSP for zig/zir filetypes, installs treesitter parser for zig, and configures neotest with neotest-zig adapter.
nodes.languageNotes: Similar pattern to r.lua: PackageManager-registered plugin with neotest adapter.

nodes.name: lsp.lua
nodes.summary: Global LSP configuration: sets vim.diagnostic.config with virtual text, signs, severity sort, underline, and float border; sets vim.lsp.config['*'] default capabilities with workspace.fileOperations didRename/willRename; defines on_attach callback mapping 13 keybindings (definition, references, implementations, type definitions, symbols, call hierarchy, code action, hover, rename, diagnostics jump, loclist) using Snacks.picker and vim.lsp.buf APIs; adds <leader>ue keymap for LspLensToggle.
nodes.languageNotes: Global LSP defaults applied to all LSP clients via vim.lsp.config['*']; on_attach is the shared keybinding hub for every language server.

nodes.name: lsp_lens.lua
nodes.summary: Registers VidocqH/lsp-lens.nvim, lazy-loaded on LSPAttach. Config disables definition and git_authors sections, customizing references and implements counts.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple plugin registration with inline config; uses require('utils').gh helper for repo string.

nodes.name: lualine.lua
nodes.summary: Registers nvim-lualine/lualine.nvim with dependency on nvim-web-devicons. Configures a custom statusline with pretty_path truncation, root_dir display, diagnostics, git diff, noice command/mode, dap status, lsp_status, progress, location, pack section, and clock. Uses Lua 5.1 unpack compatibility shim.
nodes.languageNotes: 186-line config with nested helper functions. Uses rawget(_G, 'unpack') or table.unpack for Lua 5.1 compatibility. References noice, dap, and snacks APIs within config.

nodes.name: pretty_path
nodes.summary: Returns a statusline component function that expands the current buffer path, relativizes it to cwd, truncates to a configurable length with ellipsis, and appends a readonly icon.

nodes.name: root_dir
nodes.summary: Returns a lualine component table displaying the root directory name with a custom icon and color, showing different behavior based on whether cwd is the root, a subdirectory, a parent, or unrelated.

nodes.name: mason.lua
nodes.summary: Registers mason-org/mason.nvim with dependency on mason-registry. Configures mason with uv-based pip, and registers a package install success handler that triggers FileType refresh via defer_fn.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses mr:on event handler with vim.defer_fn for async filetype refresh after package install.

nodes.name: mini.lua
nodes.summary: Registers nvim-mini/mini.nvim with 6 sub-module dependencies (diff, operators, pairs, surround, icons, visits, files). Configures mini.diff signs, mini.surround mappings, mini.files windows, mini.icons file/filetype glyphs, and mocks nvim-web-devicons via package.preload.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses package.preload shim to redirect nvim-web-devicons to mini.icons, avoiding a separate dependency.

nodes.name: namu.lua
nodes.summary: Registers bassamsdata/namu.nvim, loaded eagerly (lazy=false). Simple plugin registration without config.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal registration file; no config function.

nodes.name: neo-tree.lua
nodes.summary: Registers nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim, lazy-loaded on FileType. Configures filesystem/buffers/git_status sources, custom window mappings (copy path, open with system app, toggle preview), git status symbols, and a renderer patch. Registers TermClose autocmd for lazygit to refresh git_status source. Binds <leader>e toggle keymap.
nodes.languageNotes: Patches neo-tree.ui.renderer.window_exists to check buffer window validity. Integrates with Snacks.rename for file move/rename events.

nodes.name: on_move
nodes.summary: Callback for FILE_MOVED and FILE_RENAMED events that delegates to Snacks.rename.on_rename_file to keep snacks rename UI in sync.

nodes.name: neocodeium.lua
nodes.summary: Registers monkoose/neocodeium, loaded eagerly. Configures neocodeium.setup and binds <A-f> in insert mode to accept the suggestion.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple config with a single keymap binding for AI code completion acceptance.

nodes.name: nightfox.lua
nodes.summary: Registers EdenEast/nightfox.nvim, loaded eagerly. Simple colorscheme registration without config.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal registration file; no config function.

nodes.name: nivvie.lua
nodes.summary: Registers comfysage/nivvie.nvim, loaded eagerly. Simple theme registration without config.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal registration file; no config function.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: README.md is the project's documentation surface for the nvim-pack Neovim configuration. It introduces what this repository is — an opinionated, Lua-driven Neovim setup managed by nvim-pack and bundling 118 plugins — and gives a newcomer the context needed before diving into the code. The CONTRIBUTING.md guide next to it explains how to clone and boot the config with nvim -u ./init.lua.

tour.title: Neovim Entry Point
tour.description: init.lua is the Neovim bootstrap file and the root of the entire configuration. It requires the utils barrel, the config submodules (options, keymaps, autocmds), the package manager, and the plugins loader, then applies the shades-of-purple colorscheme via pcall. Every other module in the config exists to support what this file wires together at startup.
tour.languageLesson: Neovim runs LuaJIT (Lua 5.1), so require() is the module system and bare unpack() is the working form — table.unpack does not exist at runtime. The init.lua require chain is the dependency graph: read it top to bottom to understand startup order.

tour.title: Core Runtime Config
tour.description: The lua/config directory defines editor behavior before any plugin loads. options.lua sets global Neovim options (lazy loader, leader key, number/relativenumber, backup, spell, scroll) and wraps vim.keymap.set to enforce silent behavior. keymaps.lua defines the comprehensive keymap set, and autocmds.lua wires autocommands for auto-reload, conceallevel, formatoptions, and cursorline persistence. Together these three files establish the editor's baseline personality.

tour.title: Plugin Loader
tour.description: lua/plugins/init.lua is the vim.pack bootstrap: it globs lua/plugins/*.lua, strips numeric prefixes from filenames, loadfile()s each module, and caches results in package.loaded. It calls PackageManager.load_all() and requires the plugins.lang barrel. Its sibling lua/plugins/core.lua declares the two eagerly-loaded core dependencies — MunifTanjim/nui.nvim and nvim-lua/plenary.nvim — that other plugins depend on.
tour.languageLesson: The loader's interface IS its implementation: a glob + loadfile loop with no manifest, seam, or test surface. Numeric prefixes (00-snacks, 01-...) encode load order, and loadfile() means each module runs as a top-level script rather than a require()d module.

tour.title: Plugin Manager
tour.description: lua/utils/package_manager.lua is a custom plugin manager wrapping vim.pack.add. It collects plugin specs, dispatches them to startup, event, and filetype autocmds, and runs each plugin's config closure. The central utils barrel lua/utils/init.lua re-exports this manager alongside the install, autocmds, root, terminal, and treesitter helpers, forming the shared utility layer the rest of the config depends on.

tour.title: UI and Completion Plugins
tour.description: This step covers the first wave of plugin modules that shape the user interface. lua/plugins/00-snacks.lua configures Snacks.nvim with keybindings for the picker (files, grep, git, buffers), dashboard, and toggles. lua/plugins/blink.lua registers blink.cmp with seven dependencies including colorful-menu, blink.lib, and lazydev, configuring the completion engine that powers inline suggestions.

tour.title: Language Tooling
tour.description: The LSP, treesitter, and installer stack is configured here. lua/plugins/lsp.lua sets the global vim.diagnostic.config and vim.lsp.config defaults; lua/plugins/mason.lua registers mason.nvim with its package-install success handler; lua/plugins/treesitter.lua registers nvim-treesitter and drives highlight/indent/folds through a FileType autocmd gated by utils.treesitter.have. This is the layer that makes code editing feel intelligent.

tour.title: Formatting and Linting
tour.description: lua/plugins/conform.lua configures conform.nvim with format-on-save via a BufWritePre autocmd, toggleable through <leader>cF, with guards against running on large or non-text buffers. lua/plugins/nvim-lint.lua registers nvim-lint with filetype-aware linters. Together these two modules keep code saved on disk clean without manual intervention.

tour.title: Statusline and Health
tour.description: lua/plugins/lualine.lua registers nvim-lualine with a custom statusline showing pretty_path truncation, root_dir, and diagnostics. Its component lua/lualine/components/pack.lua extends lualine.component to display PackageManager status — a spinner while checking and a pending-update count on PackStatusChanged events. lua/health.lua is the Neovim health check module validating Neovim 0.12+ and external executables (git, make, unzip, rg).

tour.title: Language Plugins
tour.description: The lua/plugins/lang directory holds per-language plugin modules wiring treesitter, LSP servers, formatters, linters, and debuggers for each supported language. lua/plugins/lang/init.lua is the barrel loader that loadfile()s every module in the directory. Representative examples include lua/plugins/lang/lua.lua (lua-language-server, stylua, selene), lua/plugins/lang/go.lua (gopls, golangci-lint, goimports, gofumpt, gocondense), and lua/plugins/lang/rust.lua (rustaceanvim, rust-analyzer, codelldb).
tour.languageLesson: Each language module follows the same reference pattern: register the plugin via PackageManager, declare mason-installed tools, configure the LSP server, and wire treesitter parsers. New a language means adding one file in this directory and nothing else.

tour.title: Shared Utilities
tour.description: Beyond the package manager, the lua/utils directory holds reusable helpers that plugin modules depend on. lua/utils/root.lua resolves per-buffer project roots by trying detectors in order (LSP workspace folders, pattern matchers such as .git/lua, then cwd), caches results, and registers the :LazyRoot user command. lua/utils/treesitter.lua tracks installed parsers and caches per-language query availability to gate treesitter features. lua/utils/autocmds.lua exposes on_file_types and on_buf_read helpers used across plugin modules.

tour.title: Pinned Dependencies
tour.description: config:nvim-pack-lock.json is the authoritative dependency manifest pinning 118 installed plugins — blink.cmp, conform, lualine, treesitter, snacks, and more — each with a pinned git revision and source URL. The table:nvim-pack-lock.json:plugins node is the 'plugins' table inside that file mapping every plugin name to its pinned revision. This lockfile is what makes the configuration reproducible across machines.
tour.languageLesson: The lockfile table maps 118 plugin names to pinned revisions and source URLs. Treat it as the single source of truth for what is installed: a plugin is only real if it appears here, and changing a revision is a dependency change, not a config tweak.

tour.title: Toolchain Configuration
tour.description: The configuration files in the project root drive the Lua toolchain that develops this config itself. config:.luarc.json sets lua-language-server to LuaJIT runtime, disables third-party checking, links luv/busted/luassert plus ./lua, and declares vim, PackageManager, Snacks as diagnostics globals. config:.neoconf.json enables the neodev library and the lua_ls neoconf plugin. config:vim.yml declares Neovim runtime globals, config:selene.toml targets the vim standard library for the Selene linter, and config:stylua.toml sets column_width 160 with sorted requires.

tour.title: Generated Keymap Reference
tour.description: document:KEYMAP.md is the generated keymap reference for the config, organized by category — movement, window/pane, lines & editing, search, files, diagnostics, LSP on_attach, Snacks picker, git/gitsigns, terminal, quickfix/loclist, trouble, flash, yanky, conform format, neocodeium, noice, todo comments, grug-far, treesitter textobjects, snacks toggles, which-key, and filetype-specific bindings. It notes that all keymaps are made silent via lua/config/options.lua, which is why the keymap definitions in keymaps.lua omit redundant silent flags.

tour.title: Health Check and Capstone
tour.description: lua/health.lua is the Neovim health check module for nvim-pack: it validates the Neovim version (requires 0.12+), checks for external executables (git, make, unzip, rg), and reports system information via vim.uv.os_uname. It is the natural capstone to the tour — after walking the entry point, runtime config, plugin loader, plugin modules, language support, utilities, lockfile, and toolchain config, this module is where you verify that everything described above is actually runnable on a given machine.
